اعترفتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَفْتُنَّ (iʕtaraftunna) /iʕ.ta.raf.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# اُعْتُرِفْتُنَّ (uʕturiftunna) /uʕ.tu.rif.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
